lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nb3Ag5 (Nb12Ag20 per cell) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 194), with 32 atoms and five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ag centers with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Ag, 6 Nb) in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while Nb centers have 9 or 12 neighbors (12 in the latter case). Ag- and Nb-centered 12-vertex coordination polyhedra display corner-, edge-, and face-sharing, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
